data.title: SpaceX Stock Lands Upgrade, Rocket Lab Surges After Electron Mission
data.description: A recent upgrade from an analyst has recommended buying SpaceX stock due to its investment in artificial intelligence and the expected payoff timeline. Rocket Lab saw a significant increase in its stock performance following its 92nd successful Electron mission. The development resulted in a surge in Rocket Lab's stock close to a significant threshold. These updates show promising trends for both companies in the aerospace industry, with a focus on innovative technology and successful missions.

data.title: Nine unregistered crypto exchanges in Moscow City shut down by Russia for assisting in transferring scam funds overseas.
data.description: In Moscow, Russia has closed down nine unregistered cryptocurrency exchanges. The Federal Security Service (FSB) claimed that these exchanges were involved in transferring scam profits overseas through call centers in Ukraine.

data.title: Perpetual futures volume drops to $4T, lowest since late 2023. Trading hits 31-month low on exchanges, nears one-year low on decentralized platforms.
data.description: The trading volume for perpetual futures on cryptocurrency exchanges dropped to the lowest point in 31 months, pointing to a significant decline in activity. Concurrently, perpetual trading on decentralized platforms also approached a nearly one-year low, indicating a general slowdown in this sector. The decrease in trading numbers on both types of platforms suggests a reduced level of market participation and interest in perpetual futures trading within the cryptocurrency space.

data.title: OceanLight Acquisition Corporation Announces Pricing of $100 Million Initial Public Offering
data.description: OceanLight Acquisition Corporation, a blank check company based in the Cayman Islands, has disclosed the pricing details of its IPO. The company has priced its initial public offering at $10.00 per unit, with 10,000,000 units being offered. Each unit comprises one ordinary share, one right to receive one-fourth of an ordinary share post the initial business combination, and one redeemable warrant. The warrant allows the holder to purchase one ordinary share at $11.50 per share. Trading of the units on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol “OCLTU” commenced on August 7, 2026. The IPO is anticipated to conclude on August 10, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. Following the separate trading of the units, the ordinary shares and warrants are projected to trade on Nasdaq under the symbols “OCLT”, “OCLTR” and “OCLTW” respectively.

data.title: Yagi & Co., Ltd.: FUJILOOM blankets, mats that are made with “LAVATECH” containing Lava from Mt. Fuji to be Exhibited at SUPERZOO 2026
data.description: A company called Yagi & Co., Ltd. from Tokyo is set to showcase their FUJILOOM blankets and mats at SUPERZOO 2026. These products are created using "LAVATECH," which includes lava sourced from Mt. Fuji. This innovative material is a key component in the manufacturing process. The event will provide a platform for the company to exhibit their unique creations to a larger audience.

data.title: Tapestry's Culture of Curiosity Turns AI Experimentation into Business Advantage
data.description: Tapestry, Inc., a global company housing Coach and Kate Spade New York brands, conducted its second annual Future Now AI Summit at its global headquarters in New York. The event aimed to showcase the progress made by various teams in utilizing AI across the business. Over 20 cross-functional teams participated in the summit, presenting both early-stage projects and those already in the market. Among the highlights was the Consumer Insights Lab, which utilizes AI for research purposes. This gathering provided a platform for teams to collaborate, share their developments, and discuss the impact of AI on the future of the company.

data.title: AV Appoints Aerospace and Defense Executive Michael D. Ruppert to Board of Directors
data.description: Arlington based company AeroVironment, Inc. (NASDAQ: AVAV) has recently named Michael D. Ruppert to its Board of Directors, starting from August 5, 2026. Ruppert carries over 25 years of expertise in financial, strategic, and corporate development within the aerospace and defense industry. His most recent role was as EVP and CFO at ManTech from 2023 onwards, overseeing financial planning, analysis, accounting, treasury, and cash management.

data.title: Eutelsat to Play Central Role in Delivering the Next Phase of Europe’s sovereign IRIS² Connectivity Infrastructure
data.description: Paris-based company Eutelsat has been selected to be a key player in advancing Europe's independent IRIS² connectivity initiative. This development marks a significant step forward in providing essential infrastructure for the region. The selection of Eutelsat underscores the company's expertise and capabilities in this field. This decision is set to have a considerable impact on enhancing Europe's communication capabilities, benefiting millions of individuals and businesses across the continent.

data.title: Delfi Appoints Glen Fossella Chief Revenue Officer to Accelerate Go-to-Market Growth
data.description: In New York, Glen Fossella has been named Chief Revenue Officer at Delfi to enhance AI-driven balance-sheet intelligence and capital market strategies for community banks and credit unions. This appointment aims to boost services for financial institutions, leveraging Fossella's expertise in the field.

data.title: Reliance Matrix Expands Employee Navigator Integration to Simplify Absence Management
data.description: Reliance Matrix has announced the expansion of its integration with Employee Navigator for absence management in Philadelphia. Employers will now be able to seamlessly access Leave eligibility information without the need to create a separate file. This enhancement will streamline the process for employers, saving time and resources.

data.title: QumulusAI Signs Agreement With Agentic Hedge Fund To Provide NVIDIA Blackwell GPU Capacity
data.description: Atlanta-based QumulusAI (Nasdaq: QMLS) has secured a deal with an agentic hedge fund, offering competitive compute pricing and a portion of their quarterly trading gains. The hedge fund, operating exclusively through AI agents, focuses on developing and implementing trading strategies using live capital. This agreement ensures QumulusAI's involvement in the fund's operations without risking any trading losses.
